item.title: Feature request: Support `tools: ['*']` wildcard in custom agents
item.body:
## Problem

Custom agents (`.agent.md` files) require explicit tool lists in the YAML frontmatter. There is no wildcard to include "all available tools."

This creates maintenance burden and user confusion:

1. **New tools require manual updates**: When VS Code adds new built-in tools, custom agents don't automatically get access. Maintainers must update every `.agent.md` file.

2. **Tool lists are long and duplicative**: To match the default Agent's capabilities, a custom agent needs 30+ tool entries. This clutters the frontmatter and obscures the agent's actual purpose.

3. **Users expect parity**: When switching from the default Agent to a custom agent, users expect the same tools to be available. Discovering that `multi_replace_string_in_file` is missing (for example) is frustrating.

## Proposed Solution

Allow a wildcard in the `tools:` array that includes all available tools:

```yaml
---
name: My Agent
tools: ['*']  # All built-in tools + all MCP tools
---
```

Or more granularly:

```yaml
---
name: My Agent
tools: ['builtin/*', 'my-mcp-server/*']  # All built-in + specific MCP
---
```

## Current Workaround

Manually enumerate all known tools:

```yaml
tools:
  - 'my-mcp/*'
  - 'read_file'
  - 'replace_string_in_file'
  - 'multi_replace_string_in_file'
  - 'create_file'
  - 'create_directory'
  - 'list_dir'
  - 'file_search'
  - 'grep_search'
  - 'semantic_search'
  - 'list_code_usages'
  - 'get_errors'
  - 'run_in_terminal'
  - 'get_terminal_output'
  - 'terminal_last_command'
  - 'terminal_selection'
  - 'run_task'
  - 'create_and_run_task'
  - 'get_task_output'
  - 'get_changed_files'
  - 'search'
  - 'fetch'
  - 'fetch_webpage'
  - 'edit_notebook_file'
  - 'run_notebook_cell'
  - 'read_notebook_cell_output'
  - 'copilot_getNotebookSummary'
  - 'create_new_jupyter_notebook'
  - 'test_failure'
  - 'manage_todo_list'
  # ... and any others I've missed
```

This is fragile and will break as VS Code evolves.

## Use Case

I'm building a custom agent with a specific persona and instructions. The agent should have access to all the same tools as the default Agent, plus my MCP server tools. The persona and instructions are what differentiate my agent, not a restricted tool set.

## Environment

- VS Code: 1.96.x
- GitHub Copilot Chat extension: latest
- OS: Linux

comments.body: As workaround, instead of wildcards you could move tool selection to proxy level e.g. https://github.com/smart-mcp-proxy/mcpproxy-go
